explication: Servy manages arbitrary applications as Windows services through a desktop app, CLI, and real-time Manager. The central workflow is configuring or importing a service, persisting its settings, installing it through Windows service management, and having the service host launch and supervise the application. Monitoring and operational controls form a separate Manager branch. The README documents the product surfaces and capabilities; source-index references and excerpts support selected internal connections. Some implementation details, especially unsampled UI and host wiring, are therefore represented only at subsystem level.
